title: Utility Installation
text:
Utility Installation
Utility Installation
Definition
A utility installation combines division-specific devices, registers, and any reference values that are assigned to a premise and are therefore billed together, for example, an on-peak and off-peak rate meter.
An installation is assigned to exactly one contract. Only in exceptional circumstances (for example, installation under construction, asset without owner) is it not assigned to any contract.
Use
The billing-relevant data of the installation is managed
historically
. Therefore, you can change the rate category within a billing period without problem, for example.
To calculate duties that are not based on measurements,
reference values
are used. Generally, these duties are levied for the provision of energy or water. The types of reference values are as follows:
General reference values (for example, location, value to be billed, indicator for billing relevance)
Streetlights (for example, address, property status, operation types)
The energy price is calculated in connection with the burning hour calendar.
Heating installations (for example, device category description, charging control, special agreements)
Container
Integration
Integrated Components and Their Functions
The following components are integrated to control reading and billing:
Component
Function
Regional Structure
(ISU-BFRS)
For streets or cities, you can define the temperature area and meter reading unit in the regional structure, and copy these default values to the installation.
Portioning and Scheduling
(ISU-BFPS)
The scheduling defines the meter reading dates. They depend on the meter reading unit to which the installation is assigned.
Rate Structure
(ISU-BIBDRS)
The rate according to which the installation is billed depends on the general rate category to which the installation is assigned. You can use the individual rate category of the installation to override the general rate category (for example, if you have made customer-specific agreements).
Installation Structure
(ISU-DMDIIS)
The registers and rate data of devices that are installed in the installation are maintained in the installation structure.
Profiles
You can assign load profiles to an installation. The assignment refers to the identification of the corresponding load profile.
Regional Structure Default
You can use the regional structure defaults to have the system suggest the franchise contract. For this, you select the time slice to be processed and choose
Edit
Region Defaults
.
Deregulation Data
The entries that you make in the
Deregulation Fields
of the installation affect the determination of the
Deregulation Scenario
.
Other
You can change the date
Valid From
or the premise of a utility installation provided that the utility installation has not yet been assigned a contract and no devices have been installed in the utility installation.
